notes: Functional checks passed on add/remove elements, checkboxes, dropdown, dynamic controls, dynamic loading, key presses, JS alerts, login (good and bad password), sortable tables, hovers, disappearing elements, broken images, challenging DOM, status codes, context menu, entry ad, infinite scroll and floating menu. Most pages took about 30 s to reach the load event in this sandbox because an external Optimizely script hangs without network access; that is environmental and not reported. The /slow page's 30 s delay is by design. Visual and perf checks were limited to screenshots and load timing within the time budget.
